name: Cross-exchange leverage divergence
hypothesis: Pair opposite positions when matched contract economics show divergent executable basis and expected funding after costs.
spec: Setup: One perpetual venue may become crowded relative to another. Entry: Pair opposite positions when matched contract economics show divergent executable basis and expected funding after costs. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Close on convergence or either venue's risk limit. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs open-interest, funding and liquidation history at intraday resolution (not connected)
